Reproduced twice with the \"enhancement\" label. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/issues (Label filter))
bugs.expected: The label should be excluded: the address should become labels=-2 and the list should show the 5 open issues that do NOT carry \"enhancement\" (#10, #7, #4, #2, #1), as the hint \"Use alt + click/enter to exclude labels\" says.
bugs.actual: The page navigates to /issues?type=all&state=open&labels=2 (include) and shows only the one issue that carries the label (\"1 Open\" — agent11-label-B enhancement #9). The exclude request to labels=-2 is issued and then aborted. Typing labels=-2 in the address by hand gives the expected 5 results, so only the UI's exclude action is wrong. Reproduced twice with the \"enhancement\" label.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and open https://5503-ig6idqpc9wl8ew3cs6uan.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/issues (6 open issues; issue #9 carries the label "enhancement")

Type "enhancement" into the dropdown's search field so the "enhancement" item is the only one shown

Read the address and the result list

bugs.name: Sort Order field silently drops an out-of-range number and saves 0
bugs.summary: Save goes through (the dialog closes and the label is saved) but the value is silently discarded: reopening Edit shows Sort Order 0, and in the labels list "agent10/so-b" shows no order number at all, while the same form saved "10" for "agent10/so-a" and shows it beside the chip. No message, no field error — the field simply keeps a number it never stores. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/labels)
bugs.expected: The form either refuses an out-of-range Sort Order value with a message next to the field and keeps what was typed, or saves the number it accepted. Today it accepts 999999999999999999999, shows no error and stores 0 silently.
bugs.actual: Save goes through (the dialog closes and the label is saved) but the value is silently discarded: reopening Edit shows Sort Order 0, and in the labels list "agent10/so-b" shows no order number at all, while the same form saved "10" for "agent10/so-a" and shows it beside the chip. No message, no field error — the field simply keeps a number it never stores.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open /eval/harbor-handbook/labels.
Create a label named "agent10/so-b" with the Exclusive box ticked, colour #0e8a16, and type 999999999999999999999 into the "Sort Order" field that appears.
Click Save: the dialog closes and the label is created, with no error shown.

Click "Edit" on the row "agent10/so-b" (or on "agent10/so-a", created the same way with 10): the Sort Order field shows 0, and in the list "agent10/so-a" displays 10 next to its chip while "agent10/so-b" displays nothing.
